source.snippet: This was working as recently as last week but now when attempting to use a client id/secret from a connected app with the OAuth authorization code flow using a sandbox account it fails. When attempting to use OAuth authorization_code flow to obtain a code, it results in: error: OAUTH_AUTHORIZATION_BLOCKED error_description: Cross-org OAuth flows are not supported for this external client app. When attempting to retrieve a token using a refresh_token from a previously successful authorization, it [fails].

problem_statement: Salesforce developers and ISV partners face sudden, undocumented breaking changes to OAuth sandbox flows that block integration pipelines without warning, wasting engineering hours diagnosing platform-side policy changes.
target_segment: Salesforce ISV developers, integration engineers, and consulting firms maintaining Salesforce-connected apps
notes: Recent post (2026-09-03) describing a live production breakage. Business context clear: integration pipelines stopped working after a silent Salesforce platform change. Engineering time is expensive; companies pay for monitoring or changelog services to avoid this. Opportunity for a Salesforce change-monitoring/alert service or a managed OAuth proxy that abstracts platform quirks.
